note.zh: 本条产出在 WorkBuddy（Windows 桌面版）中使用 Space-Bunny 模型、极数思考档位生成，使用默认开箱配置，未加载任何 skill、插件或 MCP，也未使用自定义系统提示词。案例提示词取自 cases.json 的 skeleton-watch 条目，逐字使用，未做改写。是否一次生成：否。生成后我在本地无头浏览器（Edge + SwiftShader）做自检，共迭代八轮，修复范围包括：修正一处会抛 ReferenceError 的 const 重复声明与一处 TDZ 错误；因金属在强光下整体过曝成白板而全局重调光照与材质；重建几何——表壳内壁向内收窄会形成横贯表盘的遮挡环、镂空表须加大表圈开口，蓝宝石镜面由近平面球冠改为大半径浅穹面并模拟防眩镀膜，表带由金属平板改为深棕皮革并按佩戴弧度弯折；收窄三块夹板宽度；修正窄视口下说明面板与控制台重叠。轮系传动比、擒纵机构、摆轮游丝、爆炸视图、拾取标签与信息面板等功能逻辑未改动，但视觉与材质已与初版显著不同。我未在真实 GPU 下长时间试跑，动画节奏与最终观感建议复看。
note.en: Produced in WorkBuddy (Windows desktop) with the Space-Bunny model at the 极数 (maximum) thinking effort, using the default out-of-the-box configuration: no skills, plugins or MCP, and no custom system prompt. The prompt is the verbatim skeleton-watch entry from cases.json. One-shot: no. After generation I self-checked in a local headless browser (Edge + SwiftShader) and iterated eight rounds, fixing a duplicate const declaration that threw ReferenceError and a TDZ error; rebalancing global lighting and materials because metals initially blew out to solid white; rebuilding geometry after finding that the case inner wall narrowed inward into an occlusion ring across the dial (an openworked case needs a larger bezel aperture), changing the sapphire crystal from a near-flat spherical cap to a large-radius shallow dome with anti-reflective behaviour, and replacing the flat metal strap with dark brown leather on a wearing curve; narrowing all three bridges; and fixing info-panel/dock overlap at narrow viewports. Gear ratios, escapement, balance and hairspring, exploded view, picking labels and the info panel are logically unchanged, but the visual and material result differs substantially from the first pass. I did not soak-test on real GPU hardware, so pacing and final appearance are worth reviewing.

note.zh: 本条产出在 WorkBuddy（Windows 桌面版）中使用 Space-Bunny 模型、极数思考档位生成，使用默认开箱配置，未加载任何 skill、插件或 MCP，也未使用自定义系统提示词。案例提示词取自 cases.json 的 mythos-craft 条目，逐字使用。四项要求均已实现：Perlin 噪声地形、第一人称 WASD 与鼠标环视、方块破坏与放置（共 10 种方块）、神话幻想建筑。是否一次生成：否。生成后做了一轮返工，修复三处实际缺陷——出生点高度在区块生成前计算，getBlock 全返回 -1 会把玩家放到高空；竞技场环形高台原以噪声叠加实现，实测环内外高度仅差 0.4 格、结构不可见，改为三级同心圆人造台基并以黑曜石实心承托；getBlock 在区块未加载时返回 0 会让射线拾取与碰撞把未加载当空气而穿墙，改为返回 -1 并区分语义。地形算法已用 Python 复算校验：高度 10-34、水域约 13%、三类地表齐全。该产物未在真实浏览器中试玩，操作手感与帧率建议复看。
note.en: Produced in WorkBuddy (Windows desktop) with the Space-Bunny model at the 极数 (maximum) thinking effort, using the default out-of-the-box configuration: no skills, plugins or MCP, and no custom system prompt. The prompt is the verbatim mythos-craft entry from cases.json. All four requirements are implemented: Perlin-noise terrain, first-person WASD and mouse look, block breaking and placement (10 block types), and mythic-fantasy structures. One-shot: no. One rework round fixed three real defects: spawn height was computed before chunk generation so getBlock returned -1 everywhere and dropped the player into the sky; the arena ring was originally summed into the noise field but the measured height difference across the ring was only 0.4 blocks and the structure was invisible, so it is now a three-tier concentric platform with solid obsidian fill; and getBlock returned 0 for unloaded chunks, letting ray picking and collision treat them as air and clip through walls, so it now returns -1 with distinct semantics. The terrain algorithm was verified by re-computing it in Python: heights 10-34, about 13% water, all three surface types present. This artifact was not play-tested in a real browser, so controls feel and frame rate are worth reviewing.

note.zh: 本条产出在 WorkBuddy（Windows 桌面版）中使用 Space-Bunny 模型、极数思考档位生成，使用默认开箱配置，未加载任何 skill、插件或 MCP，也未使用自定义系统提示词。案例提示词取自 cases.json 的 pelican-cycling 条目，逐字使用。是否一次生成：基本是，仅做校验性修正。生成后仅发现初稿在两个渐变定义中混入了非法颜色字符（#b99a 与 #fbc 处的错码），虽能通过 XML 解析但颜色无效，已修正为合法十六进制；插画结构本身未再改动。已用 XML 解析器校验：无悬空 url(#id) 引用，颜色值全部合法，104 条 path 构成鹈鹕、28 个 circle 构成车轮辐条，保留 wheel-rear / bike / pelican 等语义化 id。该 SVG 未在浏览器中实际渲染确认视觉效果，画面观感建议复看。
note.en: Produced in WorkBuddy (Windows desktop) with the Space-Bunny model at the 极数 (maximum) thinking effort, using the default out-of-the-box configuration: no skills, plugins or MCP, and no custom system prompt. The prompt is the verbatim pelican-cycling entry from cases.json. One-shot: essentially yes, with a validation-only correction. After generation the first draft was found to contain two malformed colour values inside gradient definitions (corrupted glyphs where #b99a and #fbc should be); they parsed as XML but were invalid colours and were corrected to legal hex. The illustration structure itself was left as generated. Validated with an XML parser: no dangling url(#id) references, all colour values legal, 104 paths forming the pelican and 28 circles forming the wheel spokes, with semantic ids such as wheel-rear / bike / pelican retained. This SVG was not visually confirmed in a browser, so the final look should be reviewed.

note.zh: 本条产出在 WorkBuddy（Windows 桌面版）中使用 Space-Bunny 模型、极数思考档位生成，使用默认开箱配置，未加载任何 skill、插件或 MCP，也未使用自定义系统提示词。案例提示词取自 cases.json 的 cs-dust2 条目，逐字使用。交付完整 Vite + React 18 + TypeScript 工程（package.json、vite.config.ts、tsconfig.json、index.html、src/），第三方库仅 react / react-dom / three，未使用任何外部美术与音频资源，地图、角色、武器全部程序化生成，音效由 Web Audio 实时合成。八项要求均已实现。是否一次生成：否。经过较实质的返工，修复三处——App.tsx 中 React.useRef<number> 的尖括号被误写为圆括号，TSX 解析器将其当作 JSX 标签导致编译失败；类型检查暴露 9 处错误（AI 路径缺 y 字段、loop 未初始化、hitbox 部位可能为 null、applyDamage 参数类型过窄等），逐一修正后 tsc 零错误、vite 构建通过；地图连通性实测失败——导航图分裂为两个互不连通区域（225 / 116 节点），T 家无法到达 B 点、CT 家无法到达 A 点，违反提示词的区域连通硬要求，定位后发现两处根因：中路西侧 x[0,2] 隔墙连续 18 米把 B 洞与中路彻底隔开，CT 家到中路的通道仅单点相接，已重构为分段隔墙加 B 门通道并补齐 CT 下沉通道，复测为单连通分量（355 节点）、9 条关键路径全部可达。爆头伤害实测为身体的 2.5 倍，AK / M4 / AWP / 沙鹰的后坐力与射速差异均按提示词还原。工程已通过 tsc 与 vite build 并本地起服务确认可访问，但未在真实浏览器中完成 5v5 通关试玩，操作手感与 AI 行为建议复看。
note.en: Produced in WorkBuddy (Windows desktop) with the Space-Bunny model at the 极数 (maximum) thinking effort, using the default out-of-the-box configuration: no skills, plugins or MCP, and no custom system prompt. The prompt is the verbatim cs-dust2 entry from cases.json. Delivered as a complete Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project (package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, index.html, src/) depending only on react / react-dom / three, with no external art or audio assets: map, characters and weapons are procedurally generated and sound is synthesized live with Web Audio. All eight requirements are implemented. One-shot: no. Substantial rework fixed three real defects: in App.tsx the angle brackets of React.useRef<number> were written as parentheses, so the TSX parser treated them as a JSX tag and the build failed; type checking surfaced 9 errors (missing y on AI path points, uninitialised loop, nullable hitbox part, an over-narrow applyDamage parameter type, etc.), all fixed so tsc is clean and vite builds; and map connectivity testing failed — the navigation graph split into two mutually disconnected regions (225 / 116 nodes), with T spawn unable to reach B site and CT spawn unable to reach A site, violating the prompt requirement that all areas be connected by Dust2 real routes. Two root causes were found: a west-mid wall at x[0,2] ran continuously for 18 metres and severed B tunnels from mid, and the CT-to-mid passage met mid only at a single point. The wall is now segmented with a B-doors passage and the CT descent path is completed; re-testing shows a single connected component of 355 nodes with all 9 key routes reachable. Measured headshot damage is 2.5x body damage, and AK / M4 / AWP / Deagle recoil and rate-of-fire follow the prompt. The project passes tsc and vite build and was served locally to confirm it loads, but no full 5v5 playthrough was completed in a real browser, so controls feel and AI behaviour are worth reviewing.

note.zh: 本条产出在 WorkBuddy（Windows 桌面版）中使用 Space-Bunny 模型、极数思考档位生成，使用默认开箱配置，未加载任何 skill、插件或 MCP，也未使用自定义系统提示词。案例提示词取自 cases.json 的 beihai-meteorite 条目，逐字使用。交付完整 Vite + TypeScript 工程，运行时依赖仅 three，未使用任何外部资产、CDN 或第三方音效库，视觉与音效全部由代码程序化生成。总时长 348 秒（四幕 27 个镜头，片头片尾均计入），在 360 秒硬上限内；11 套体素场景；32 条字幕全部集中于 src/cues.ts 的结构化清单，每条固定包含 id / kind / speaker / text / delivery / start / end 七个字段，显示统一为画面底部居中的【说话者】文本，未生成或合成任何人声；音效遵守物理环境约束——地下室枪声经多抽头延迟反馈模拟强烈反射混响，真空场景外部枪声不传播、仅用低频闷震与航天服呼吸的主观化表现。是否一次生成：否。返工两处——字幕初稿混入三处英文词与一处乱码字符，已改为通顺中文；主程序 rumble 分支的参数类型判断写错导致 tsc 报错，同时清理了一处未使用的死变量。已通过校验：tsc 零错误、vite 构建通过、镜头时间轴连续无隙、字幕七字段完整且无重叠与越界、相机插值无 NaN。该影片未在真实浏览器中实际观看，剪辑节奏、构图与配乐表现建议复看。
note.en: Produced in WorkBuddy (Windows desktop) with the Space-Bunny model at the 极数 (maximum) thinking effort, using the default out-of-the-box configuration: no skills, plugins or MCP, and no custom system prompt. The prompt is the verbatim beihai-meteorite entry from cases.json. Delivered as a complete Vite + TypeScript project whose only runtime dependency is three, with no external assets, CDNs or third-party audio libraries; all visuals and sound are procedurally generated in code. Total runtime 348 seconds across four acts and 27 shots (titles and credits included), within the 360-second cap; 11 voxel scenes; 32 subtitles all held in a structured manifest in src/cues.ts, each with exactly the seven fields id / kind / speaker / text / delivery / start / end, rendered uniformly as bottom-centred speaker-labelled text, with no human voice generated or synthesised. Sound respects the physics of each environment: underground gunfire gets a strong multi-tap delay-feedback reverb, while in vacuum no external shot propagates and only a low-frequency muffled thud and subjective suit breathing are used. One-shot: no. Two reworks: three English words and one corrupted glyph had leaked into the first subtitle draft and were replaced with fluent Chinese; and the rumble branch in the main program had an incorrect argument type check that broke tsc, along with one unused dead variable removed. Verified: tsc clean, vite build succeeds, the shot timeline is continuous with no gaps, subtitles have complete seven-field records with no overlap or out-of-range entries, and camera interpolation produces no NaN. The film was not actually watched in a real browser, so pacing, composition and sound design are worth reviewing.
